title: The Body as City: Sense-Storehouses and the Mind of Light at the Gates
description: Each sense is an enthumesis with its own storehouses, granaries, caverns, and treasuries. The heart is king and cellarer over the five enthumeses; gates have archon-watchmen who refuse strangers and admit fellow-citizens. The Mind of Light arrives at the gates of this body-city to humble the gate-archons and seize the keys of all the senses — illumined rational understanding dispossessing the proprium's rule over the senses in regeneration.
